participation.context: Listened, refused a price, and went on.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You let him say the two and the four. You told him you were not buying, and you walked on.

title: Heard two for one where it should be four

participation.context: attendee in Short in the ear
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You stopped where the ears were short, with the hills and the cloud in front of you.

title: Stopped where the barley was short in the ear
